description_en: Creates a storage analysis task to query the usage details of one or more databases and tables
description_zh: 调用CreateStorageAnalysisTask接口，创建空间分析任务，获取数据库及表的空间使用数据
name: CreateStorageAnalysisTask

parameters.help_en:
The node ID. For ApsaraDB for MongoDB instances, you can use this parameter to specify a node for storage analysis. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/123802.html operation to query the information about nodes of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance.

If you set this parameter to a value in the InsName format, such as `d-bp1872fa24d5****`, you can call this operation to analyze the hidden node that corresponds to the node ID.

If you set this parameter to a value in the `InsName#RoleId` format, such as `d-bp1872fa24d5****#299****5`, you can call this operation to analyze the specified node.

If you run a storage analysis task on an ApsaraDB for MongoDB replica set instance and you do not specify this parameter, only the hidden node of the instance is analyzed by default. If you run a storage analysis task on an ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instance, we recommend that you set this parameter to specify a node
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。
对于MongoDB实例，通过该参数指定节点进行空间分析。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/123802.html接口，可以查询MongoDB实例各个节点的详细信息。

当传入目标节点的InsName（节点ID）时，例如`d-bp1872fa24d5****`，调用该接口分析其对应的Hidden节点。
当传入目标节点的`InsName#RoleId`时，例如`d-bp1872fa24d5****#299****5`，调用该接口分析指定的节点。

<notice>对于MongoDB副本集实例，不传入此参数时，调用该接口会默认分析唯一的Hidden节点。对于MongoDB分片集群实例，推荐传入此参数，指定目标节点。</notice>
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The database name. If you specify a database, the operation analyzes the storage usage of the specified database
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名。传入该参数时，分析指定数据库的空间使用情况
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The table name. If you specify a table in the specified database, the operation analyzes the storage usage of the specified table. If you specify a table, you must also specify the database to which the table belongs by using DbName
parameters.help_zh: 表名。传入该参数时，分析指定数据库中指定表的空间使用情况。传入该参数时，必须同时传入DbName，指定该表所属的数据库
parameters.name: table_name
